'''2007 Maryland State Championship Mike Battaglia LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Battaglia]] at [[2007 Maryland State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' Blue
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
